_comment: The estimator's adjustable variables. These are the file defaults; the sliders in the dashboard override them per-browser without touching this file. Edit here to change the starting point for everyone.
_sell_through_rate: Share of uploaded stock assumed to sell. 0.20 = one in five.
_markup: Markup on cost price. 1.00 = 100%, i.e. you roughly double your money, so profit is markup / (1 + markup) = 50% of the sale price. The dashboard shows both figures.
_average_item_value: Expected sale price per item. null means 'use the mean of the prices in crosslist/items.csv', recalculated on every build. Set a number here to override it.
_monthly_profit_target: The target the 'upload X more items' prompt is measured against.
_break_even_target: Total estimated profit needed to get back to zero on what has been spent on stock. A running total, not a monthly figure — every upload chips away at it.
_break_even_days: The deadline the planner works its uploads-per-day figure back from.
_live_from: Nothing before this counts as live, and no average reaches back past it. A listing is live only if its Last Listed is on or after this moment and it has no sold date. Set it to a bare date like '2026-06-22' to take the whole day. Build-time only.
_export_skip_rows: How many rows at the top of the store export are the first batch, already counted from crosslist/items.csv. Those rows are not re-counted as uploads, but their live/sold status IS read — that file is the only place status is recorded. Build-time only; there is no slider for it.
_rate_unit: Whether the planner and projection show rates per 'day' or per 'month'. Toggleable on the page; rates are held per-day internally, so switching never drifts the number.
_pace_window_days: Days used to work out the current upload pace. 0 means 'since your first logged upload'. Set e.g. 30 for a rolling 30-day window once there is more history.
